summary: NatWest Group plc furnished a Form 6-K disclosing initial notifications of transactions by persons discharging managerial responsibilities under Article 19 of the UK Market Abuse Regulation, the US equivalent of a Section 16 insider transaction report. Nine PDMRs, including Chair Rick Haythornthwaite and Senior Independent Director Lena Wilson, acquired ordinary shares at 7.0990 each on 18 September 2026 through reinvestment of the ordinary dividend paid that day. Holdings range from 12 to 823 shares. No board recommendation, advisor, or deal mechanics apply; this is a routine disclosure with no special-situation or risk-arb angle.
